landing.eyebrow: Built for Rwanda's community health workers
landing.heroBody: ZeroMalaria helps community health workers triage malaria, catch danger signs early and hand patients over to the health centre, even with no connection.
landing.problemTitle: The loop breaks between the village and the clinic.
landing.problem1B: Danger-sign checks vary from one visit to the next.
landing.problem2B: A paper slip leaves the village and is never confirmed.
landing.problem3B: Districts see surges and stock-outs after the week they needed to act.
landing.how1B: One question at a time: age, fever, danger signs, RDT. Works fully offline.
landing.how2B: Clinical rules decide urgency. The health worker reviews and confirms.
landing.how3B: A digital referral with QR code reaches the health centre inbox.
landing.how4B: If the patient never arrives, the health worker is alerted to follow up.
landing.whoChwB: Guided triage in the village, in Kinyarwanda, with voice.
landing.whoSupB: Team, patients and follow-ups for one facility.
landing.whoRbcB: Live map, surge signals, referral funnel, stock pressure.
landing.safetyTitle: AI assists. Rules decide. People confirm.
landing.layer1B: Danger signs always mean urgent referral. Never downgraded.
landing.layer2B: May only raise urgency, never lower it, and explains why.
landing.layer3B: Helps with words and voice. Never diagnoses, never names drugs.
landing.voiceTitle: Speaks Kinyarwanda. Listens for yes or no.
landing.voiceBody: Questions are read aloud from a fixed, reviewed phrase catalogue, so the health worker can keep their eyes on the patient.
landing.offlineBody: Every assessment is saved safely and sends itself when the network comes back.
landing.ctaTitle: Zero malaria deaths starts in the village.
landing.ctaBody: Sign in with your account, or request access from your supervisor.
landing.footerBuilt: AI for Public Good Hackathon · University of Rwanda · UR UNIPOD
